# Operations Teller Performance and Cash Flow Monitoring Guidelines

This document details the essential monitoring and review activities for operational efficiency.

*   Monitor teller performance on a quarterly basis.
*   Review customer wait times based on audit findings.
*   Update teller performance records quarterly.
*   Monitor cash flow urgently.
*   Update cash flow data for the 2026 strategy.
